title: refactor(internal): share approval announce and small cleanups
body:
- execution: ApprovalDesk::ask and the Always channel share a private
  ApprovalDesk::announce for id allocation + ApprovalRequested emit
- approval_wbtest: drop "a decision for a settled question is discarded"
  (subsumed by "an interrupted wait still retires its question") and an
  unused with_task_group wrapper
- workspace_path: path_basename/parent_dir call workspace_compare_path
- cli: terminal_safe_line matches control chars with char-range patterns
- commands/sessions: drop single-use bindings around @fs.mtime
- commands/mcp: compute the terminal-safe config path once; destructure
  (name, tools) in the for header
- testkit/filesystem: inline the with_tmpdir cleanup into defer
- setup: trim_trailing_path_separators uses a view pattern loop

Part of a repo-wide simplification round (obvious wins, dedupe, low-value/duplicate test removal). Behavior-preserving; `moon info` shows no `.mbti` change.
